protocol.only_condition_difference: coupling source matrix; shared real VNC continuous phase source
protocol.phase_source: continuous_phase.vnc_phase_source real VNC phase, shared across conditions
protocol.coupling_equation: theta_i[t] = theta_i[t-1] + source_delta_i[t] + g * sum_j K[i,j] * sin(theta_j[t-1-D[i,j]] - theta_i[t-1])
protocol.engine: continuous_phase.run_engine / StepGaitEngine.continuous_targets; fixed Path-1 waveform

coupling.edge_source: audit_intersegmental.cross_edges official T1/T2/T3 edges at absolute synapse floor 5
coupling.sign_source: fetch_manc.nt_signs predicted_nt: acetylcholine +1; GABA/glutamate -1; unknown omitted
coupling.row_normalization: each post-leg row divided by its own absolute signed raw K row sum; fixed anatomy-only input scaling
coupling.shuffled_rule: permute signed nonzero raw K entries across the fixed real nonzero mask
coupling.random_rule: independently permute raw magnitudes and signs across the fixed real nonzero mask

dc2_calibration.selection_rule: Among admissible cells, select the one with the smallest per_hop_steps, breaking ties by the largest gain. Selection uses only the neutral phase-locked and bounded criteria across all three conditions.

pre_registered_null: real delayed coupling does not produce a walking anti-phase tripod beating shuffled/random on coherence and feet-planted -> DELAY-COUPLING-NULL; the zero-training coordination ceiling holds
pre_registered_positive: real edges + the declared delay produce a stable anti-phase tripod that walks, with low falls and positive forward path, beat both controls on coherence and feet-planted with Holm-corrected p < 0.05 and non-overlapping bootstrap CIs, and the watched real video shows a genuine tripod walk -> DELAY-COUPLING-EARNED
